resolution.note: sampler records hashed account and both resets

title: A plan sample names its account and both resets
body:
Outcome: each row of `.krn/plan/samples.jsonl` carries a hashed account label and the five-hour and seven-day reset times.
Why: rows hold `time, session, five_hour, seven_day` only.
Proof: a test feeds a verbatim status-line payload and reads the new fields; an old row still parses.
Scope: the status-line sampler and its test; no printing (S10). Under 1 point.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-program-v2/06-program.md section 2, slice S3.
Operator order 2026-11-10: "Odpalaj" (program v2 planned on Fable).
